_note: God-game look test (docs/pivot/god-game.md, slice 1). Presentation and feel values only; nothing here feeds the strategy game. Distances in metres at character scale (1 unit = 1 m).

scale._note: The culture kits were built at campaign kit scale (door 1.1 m, storey 1.25 m); the look test builds them at kit_scale so a door is 2.2 m. The campaign map is drawn at campaign_scale around the character-scale area so Frosthold lines up. The god is god_height (1.5x a 1.8 m human).

area._note: The character-scale area around Frosthold: half_size metres each way, the heightfield at cell metres, relief added on the campaign heights and faded out over edge_fade metres so it meets the campaign terrain.

rise._note: The rise to the empire view: from pull_from metres above the ground the flight camera pulls back; at empire_at the camera hands over to the campaign zoom (core/camera_rig.gd at campaign_scale) and the character-scale world fades out by fade_end. The cloud deck sits at cloud_height.

render._note: Measured on the look test (see the report): SSIL and SDFGI cost more than they gave at this scale, TAA is the anti-aliasing.
